video.title: I am attending Microsoft Build in San Francisco! #microsoftpartner

transcript.text: Every developer, including me, is going
to be in San Francisco this June for
Microsoft Build. And if you are not,
then you will miss out.
>> Microsoft Build is back for 2026, and it
feels like a conference purely for
developers who actually ship code. One
session I'm genuinely interested in
attending is DEM312,
called Multi-Agents in Action with three
AI agents, three frameworks, tools, and
models. It works through three AI agents
built with different frameworks, tools,
and models, all working together in real
time. There are a lot of talks with real
code, real systems, and real workflows
that you can learn from and also apply
in your work immediately.
>> Microsoft Build is not just talks and
sessions. You can walk out with actual
implementation patterns, code you can
ship, and also connect with other
builders in the conference. Honestly,
this is the kind of content I wish I had
early in my developer journey. I'm so
excited to attend Microsoft Build and
connect with other developers. It is
happening online and also live in person
on 2nd and 3rd of June in San Francisco.
Spots are limited, so don't sleep on it.
Save $200 on my coupon code. The link is
in description and comment section. See
you there.
